notes.title: Screencheat Publishing + Soundtrack Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody! 

We’re happy to announce that Screencheat is now fully self-published by Samurai Punk, allowing us to finally declare this game to be 100% “indie AF”.

To celebrate, our talented musician Psilatron (formerly ana_mana) has graced us with a slew of hot new tracks to update the Screencheat soundtrack! These five bonus tracks were inspired by the sounds and vibes of the Nintendo 64-era, particularly Goldeneye 64 which we’re told was pretty popular. 

The soundtrack is available to stream on Youtube and to purchase on Bandcamp.
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLN-WtPJwdbL6P1y_zjA6EQVGYvHTvUYXL
https://psilatron.bandcamp.com/album/screencheat-original-soundtrack

Plus, those with the Deluxe Edition will be receiving an updated OST with the bonus tracks and the whole thing in glorious FLAC. There’s also dope new cover artwork. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6410511/7e3719e0fc2aa13294cac7ba43f401626cf15095.jpg[/img]

We’ve also added a cheeky link to our Discord for the Samurai Punk community, our cute little corner of the interwebs where you can hang with cool peeps and find out about our latest developments. Sign up here: http://discord.gg/samuraipunk

Thanks again for your continued support and we hope you enjoy the new songs! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk 
<3

notes.title: 3.2.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We’ve been busy the past few months preparing for Screencheat for PS4 and Xbox One (which comes out on March 1st, by the way), but that doesn’t meant we haven’t been working on the Steam version too! We have a load of improvements for you guys, the biggest addition being full text localisation for Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean! We hope that everything in this update improves the experience for you guys, and thanks again for your continued support! 

Changes, Additions and Improvements
[list]
[*]Added new Samurai Punk logo to splash screen
[*]Added full text localisation for Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean
[*]Made bots better with Hobby Horse and Bear Bomb
[*]Updated old assets in Garden
[*]Added Ivy asset to Temple to help diversify the sides of the green path
[*]Re-arranged paintings on Manor to help distinguish vague areas
[*]Increased the resolution of some level textures
[*]Remastered all levels with a new shader to help improve performance on core level geometry. Additionally all levels repeated assets how now been manually batched heavily. This should improve CPU overhead on most hardware
[*]As a result of the new shader lighting quality and resolution has been improved slightly on all maps
[*]Trappeur bolts now have a small amount of vertical velocity when fired to give them a slightly parabolic path
[*]Added coloured lightning effect to Trappeur’s laser
[*]Improved Trappeurs bending to clip through walls less
[*]Changed wall_Hacker laser sight to be a dotted line to help distinguish it as non-lethal
[*]Tweaked godrays to improve CPU performance
[*]Allow re-binding secondary text-chat key in keybinding menu
[*]Improvements to AI movement, especially while jumping or using jump pads
[*]Significantly improved static UI efficiency for better performance
[*]Improvements to Australian Edition mutator
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fix GUI resizing issues after join mid-game transition
[*]Don’t increase player win count for tie games
[*]Fix “1 second to respawn” being stuck on screen when a player is Eliminated
[*]Fix mutators resetting when returning to lobby
[*]Fix bots sometimes not replacing a user when they leave in a lobby with bots fill slots enabled
[*]Fix UI overlay issue when confirming weapon skins
[*]Fixed exposed back faces on Helix Railing and minor mesh seams
[*]Removed many tiny seams on many maps
[*]Fix not being able to confirm control scheme in-game
[*]Ragdoll/skin unlock message in lobby will now update when language is changed
[*]Fixed Ascension Time Trial AI spawns to stop them spawning on top of the player
[*]End-game UI will update for the new host when the host changes
[*]Scoreboard screen now deals with players leaving
[*]Fix winner camera when players leave at the end-game screen
[*]Fix bug with Patience achievement
[*]Fix bug with Sky Captain achievement
[*]Bomb Assault stability fixes
[*]Fix loads of small animation bugs with some weapons
[*]Fix UI sound inconsistencies
[*]Fixed an exploit when picking up a pinata/bomb whilst charging with a charge weapon
[*]Fix friendly fire option not saving correctly
[*]Fix text entry not working in Steam Big Picture
[*]Remove slow-mo effect on suicides when slow-mo kills mutator enabled
[*]Crossbow bolts will now clear themselves
[*]Fix charge weapons interacting poorly with objective pickups
[*]Reset player’s crosshair when they die in Murder Mystery and lose their gun
[/list]

Known Issues
[list]
[*]Some players may have issues connecting a mix of X-Input and Direct Input controllers
[*]Due to an engine bug, increasing graphics quality from very low/low will crash the game on Windows. Upon re-launching the game, the graphics quality will be updated correctly. We will patch this as soon as Unity release a fix. 
[*]Creating and leaving a LAN room may prevent players from being able to create or join LAN or online games until they close and re-open the game
[/list]
Thanks for your help reporting and tracking these problems down. Happy screencheating! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: 3.1.0 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

We've been listening to your feedback and have a bunch of fixes and improvements for you! Here's the rundown:

Changes and Improvements
[list]
[*]GUI performance optimisations
[*]Added Xbox One controller support for Mac
[*]Prevent resolution changes via registry from being overridden on startup
[*]Added Player Settings in Gamemode Settings, allowing you to change movement, jump speed and gravity
[*]One Shot: Suicide no longer grants a new bullet
[*]One Shot: Max score cap increased from 10 to 50
[*]Add info tooltips when new ragdolls/skins unlocked
[*]Add info tooltips for new users
[*]Bot icons indicate bot difficulty
[*]Inputting profile name text will show text in uppercase
[*]In-game music track will shuffle when you rematch or play next round after the current song has been played at least once
[*]Lobby browser will now show lobbies playing in team modes correctly
[*]Default/Inverted guest profiles will now be named “Guest X” instead of “Default”/”Inverted”
[*]Bot AI is computed on the host machine only
[/list]

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fix UI elements being obscured in 8 player
[*]Fix text chatbox sometimes covering player names
[*]Don’t play “5 kills to win” when a player had a negative score and scored up to 0
[*]Fixed some cases where you could respawn in elimination style modes
[*]Fix being able to concede a point if you win an elimination round and die during the next round countdown
[*]Fixed some weapon crates not having meshes
[*]Fix some controller icons not switching when going from Xbox One to PS4 controllers
[*]Don’t show “Press (A) to join” for unrecognised controllers that have not been configured
[*]Fix lobby browser showing lobbies being in Party Mode incorrectly
[*]Prevent controller icons from switching in pause menus when a non-paused player uses their controller
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]AI bots can cause bad performance on low-end machines
[/list]

Thanks for your help reporting and tracking these problems down. Happy screencheating! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk

notes.title: 3.0.0 Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Screencheat Anniversary Update

We launched Screencheat a year ago and what better way to celebrate than with another major update including some of the dream features on our wishlist!

Headlining this update is the localisation of the game into six languages. Now you can cheat in French, German, Spanish, Russian, Dutch or Portuguese as well as English. 

We’ve also added AI bots into Screencheat. This will give you someone to play against while you wait for your friends to come online and to allow small playgroups to experience larger games. And for experienced Screencheaters, you’ll be able to find a serious challenge with the Dreamcrusher AI difficulty. The AI are able to be mixed in with online and local players and will be replaced when players join mid game.  We hope you enjoy them!

Rounding out the major additions are LAN play for all you competitive players out there and a new map, bringing the total to eleven. Museum II brings some of the familiar design elements from the original Museum across whilst giving it a more vertical and competitive feel to make the map great for new players as well as screencheating veterans. 

We can’t quite believe how fast this year has gone and how far the game has come from the initial version we launched. 

Additions
[list]
[*] AI Bots for online and offline play, with three difficulty levels. Bots settings can be modified in the lobby. Individual bots can be selected and tweaked in the lobby. 
[*] Added localisation for German, French, Spanish, Russian, Dutch and Portuguese
[*] LAN play can now be accessed via the online menu
[*] New map: Museum II
[*] 4 Ragdolls including the Cat/Snake/Duck/Mannequin unlocked at levels 3/12/17/22
[*] New mutators: SlowMo Kills, Ice Skates
[*] Allow setting custom descriptions for custom gamemodes
[*] Added support for Steam Controllers [url=https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Betas]REQUIRES STEAM BETA CLIENT[/url] (For the best experience play in Big Picture)
[*] Added Legacy and Legacy Southpaw control schemes for controllers
[*] Added latency/ping indicator in scoreboard and end-game screen
[/list]

Fixes and Improvements
[list]
[*] Steeple visuals have been tweaked slightly and are now slightly nicer and more optimised.
[*] Garden visuals have been cleaned up removing some visible seams and adding some better materials.
[*] Emir now has railings to help stop players from falling to their deaths so much in some areas.
[*] Fix “Press (X) to drop” prompt not appearing properly
[*] Raised the maximum score cap on Juggernaut to 50
[*] Fixed issue where editing profile name with WASD keys could navigate the menu
[*] Updated Chefolet crosshair to animate showing charge progress
[*] Allow setting server size to be any number from 2 - 8
[*] Improved collision on Temple
[*] Show won by default if a player/team wins from other players leaving
[*] Improve player highlight UI in lobby
[*] Kick votes will expire after 90 seconds
[*] Fix UI issues if a menu is open while the game countdown begins
[*] Added Stock and Team Stock as default custom gamemodes when you have no custom game modes
[*] Fix controller emotes breaking when switching between two controller types
[*] Change unslot on keyboard to use “X” key
[*] Add ability to customise bot settings when creating a server
[*] Bomb Assault: Fix bug where you respawn instantly the first time
[*] Prevent picking up a weapon from a crate if you’re holding a pickup
[*] Allow using English kill messages if your language is set to something other than English
[*] Added setting language via Steam interface 
[*] Bomb Assault: Fix “Your base are all explode” popup not showing if your base is destroyed while you are dead
[/list]

Known Issues
[list]
[*] Players may not match their colours/scores after repeated leaving/joining mid-game
[*] Players may still intermittently lose progress from sessions. 
[*] Game sometimes crashes after game ends on Mac
[/list]

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: 2.1.8 Patch
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we’re rolling out a fresh patch with a tonne of usability improvements and bugfixes! 

Changes/Additions
[list]
[*]Revolver Rifle: Increased the radius of the hit cylinder from 0.01 to 0.25 units
[*]Backspace/X on controller is now used to unslot in the lobby instead of Escape/B
[*]Emotes such as (X) no longer show as controller icons in player names
[*]Made mouse aim invert and sensitivity a global setting which can be modified in the Options > Controls menu
[*]Added kill reporting to generate heatmaps
[*]Add Ragdoll Clearing option in Graphics settings. If enabled, ragdolls will be cleared on round restart after 75 have appeared in single session on a map, or if 100 exist at once. The ability to scale this setting will be added in a future patch.
[/list]

Gameplay Fixes/Improvements
[list]
[*]Add maximum screenshake cap to prevent excessive screenshake bugs
[*]Fixed a slight gameplay pause at end-game
[*]Re-added Hobby Horse to One Shot (thanks to xFats for the recommendation!)
[*]Crossbow: Bolts now interact better with moving objects
[*]Rumble will pause when the game is paused
[*]Fixed issues with pickups getting stuck in vents
[*]Fixed issues with pickups in the tunnel on Loop
[*]Fixed a bug where you could sometimes shoot through walls. Thanks to IamNic for reporting this one
[*]Improved pickup/drop animation for pickups
[*]Improved physics efficiency on Emir
[*]Fix not gaining any XP when you have a negative score
[/list]

UI Fixes/Improvements
[list]
[*]Fix profile duplication bug. Any duplicated profiles will be automatically removed, leaving the copy of the profile with the highest level.
[*]Add ability to set a Favourite Weapon to your profile. You will start the game with your favourite weapon if it is available in that match.
[*]Add a Controls tab to the Options menu which contains all control options
[*]Add a confirmation prompt when attempting to delete custom controller bindings
[*]Fixed “Press X to Jason” to show proper (X) symbol for PlayStation controllers
[*]Fixed “(B)” controller icon always showing for exiting to Lobby in the end-game screen
[*]Streamline the options in the Profile Menu so that players only see options relevant to their control type (keyboard or controller)
[*]Fix the “Eliminated” message not showing for the last player killed in elimination style modes
[*]Added score to win/time limit in scoreboard
[*]Fix server name not showing properly 
[*]Fix Bombs Away bomb countdown indicator sometimes clipping into other screens
[*]Improve the unrecognised controller popup to work with XInput
[*]Show a warning when more than 4 XInput controllers are connected (as only 4 are supported at once)
[/list]

Known Issues
[list]
[*]Custom Keyboard Bindings menu may not work on Windows machines
[/list]

As always, thanks for your support and happy screencheating! 

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: 2.1.7 Patch - XInput and Custom Controllers
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’ve added XInput support (enabled by default) which will now allow for rumble on XInput devices and should support more controllers out of the box. This will also fix the issues with Xbox One controllers on Windows 10. 
Players who used custom controller bindings will need to disable XInput in the game settings menu, as they are not supported by XInput. Please let us know if you guys have any issues going forward with controllers or binding. 

Also, we’d like to apologise for the frequency of patches recently and for accidentally giving, then removing, the Deluxe Edition DLC from users who did not own it previously. This was due to a mistake we made and [b]should[/b] now be resolved. Users who own the Deluxe Edition should still have the soundtrack so let us know if you don’t see it. 

As thanks to everyone who has put up with our $#*& over the last week, we’ve made you a cool new Revolver Rifle skin! 

[img=http://samuraipunk.info/files/capture_1024.png]

We really appreciate your continued support and feedback on the game. You’ve all been incredibly helpful in helping us to improve the game and give you the best possible experience. Thank you! :)

Bugfixes and Improvements (Including 2.1.6 hotfixes)
[list]
[*]Controller rumble added to all weapons and to certain player actions. If you don’t enjoy the rumble, you can disable it by turning off Screen Shake in the game options. (There’ll be a separate option in a future patch.)
[*]Xbox One controllers now use XInput and will not drift to the left in menus on Windows 10. Note that this drifting will reoccur if you disable XInput. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would sometimes slow down or crash after startup
[*]Fixed an issue where training dummies would spawn at strange angles on some maps
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred when a player left during during game start or restart. This showed as all players seeing the preview camera overlaid with the in game GUI.
[*]Fixed an issue where Windows 10 users weren’t loading their profiles from the Steam Cloud, or having any other Steam functionality. This may have made some players think they had lost their profiles, but no such loss occurred.
[*]Steam Achievements now appear in the Steam Overlay immediately upon unlocking them.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]Xbox One controllers in XInput mode show Xbox 360 style controller button icons
[/list]

Much Love,
Samurai Punk
<3

notes.title: Screencheat Update 2.0 - The Omega
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Welcome to another huge Screencheat update. We've added new maps, a weapon, a game mode, team modes for everything, and heaps more!

[h1]2 New Maps Added[/h1]
Temple -  A beautiful zen temple featuring jump pads, vent shortcuts and super high vantage points.
Loop -  A gravity defying map with a track running around the outside which the players follow all the way until the map flips and loops around back to the top, all set to a serene starlit vista.

[h1]New Weapon Added  - The wall_Hacker[/h1]
This new gun fires through walls as the name implies with a near infinite range. It can be either blindfired or charged to show a laser sight which can easily pin-point other players on their screens. The wall_Hacker is a precision weapon with a long reload time so aim your shots carefully. 

[h1]New Game Mode - Gold Rush[/h1]
Gold Rush pits players against each other in short rounds where the map is filled with gold coins. Players must collect as many coins as they can within the time limit to win. If you’re killed holding any coins you will drop half of them, allowing other players to rush in and claim your stash! 

[h1]Support for up to 8 players Locally and Online[/h1]
Lobbies can be created for 8 players, or switched into 8 player mode under the Lobby Settings menu. Local Lobbies now contain the Lobby Settings tab to support this.

[h1]Team Variant of All Modes (ex. Juggernaut)[/h1]
All modes (excluding Juggernaut) now have team variants which allow for 2-4 teams to play against each other. These can be customised and saved as custom modes just like standard modes.  

[h1]Mutators[/h1]
We’ve added 13 crazy Mutators which can be applied to any mode via the GameMode settings menu in the Lobby. 

[h1]Online Improvements[/h1]
Kick Voting -  Players can now vote to kick each other from servers. They will be kicked if a majority votes for a single player to be kicked.
Switching Host - The host is able to select any remote player in their lobby and assign them as host.

[h1]4 new Ragdolls[/h1]
These can be unlocked by leveling up your profiles to new milestones.

[h1]Juicy Soundtrack Update[/h1]
The official soundtrack by ana_mana has now been professionally mixed and mastered. 

[h1]3 new achievements to unlock[/h1]
Check them out in Library!

[h1]New Gamemode Settings[/h1]
[list][*]Weapon Swap Type: Switch at Spawn, Free Switching and Weapon Crates
Show Campers: Reveal players who have not moved for at least 10 seconds
Show Weapon Trails: Can toggle weapon smoke trails on and off[/list]

[h1]Design/Balance Changes[/h1]
[list][*]New, less punishing Murder Mystery design
Bear Bomb explosion radius up from 5.5 - 7 units
Players now have less aerial drag and will have momentum when moving through the air. [/list]


[h1]Other fixes and Improvements[/h1]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list][*]Ability to view detailed scoreboard and kick players in-game by pressing TAB or Back on controller
[*]Fixed Murder Mystery Crate spawns on Steeple.
[*]Pick Up Items will now move through Vents and get thrown by Jump Pads.
[*]Physics improvements
[*]Added self-kill messages and sound effect
[*]Various online stability fixes
[*]Skeleton Ragdoll now even more fun[/list]


[h1]Art/Sound[/h1]
[list][*]Crossbow visuals redesigned to better convey its mechanics
[*]Added new announcer clips as well as missing clips for older modes.
[*]Switch animations added to all weapons
[*]Golden Blunderbuss (preorder/beta bonus) now looks much better
[*]Added Screenshake effect to weapons (Can be disabled under game options)
[*]General re-work of some sound effects.
[*]Added a negative kill sound for when you don’t receive a point or commit suicide.
[*]Minor map art cleanup
[*]Revised lightmapping on all maps[/list]

[h1]GUI[/h1]
[list][*]Usability improvements for controllers
[*]Steam Big Picture support
[*]Tidying up of visuals to provide a more consistent UI experience
[*]Added tabs to Gamemode Select to switch between Default, Team and [*]Custom modes
[*]Art for Murder Mystery cards updated
[*]Lobby slots show different controller buttons for each type of connected controller
[*]Updated icon and banner for Random Map[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list][*]The programmers learnt why you should write lists. They can’t keep track of it all.
[*](But in all seriousness, we fixed lots of things)[/list]

Much Love, 
Samurai Punk 
<3

notes.title: Content Drop #1 Is Live - Changelog Is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://engagementengine.s3.amazonaws.com/community/articles/normal/content-drop-1-is-now-live-ve.jpg[/img]

Hello Screencheaters! It has been amazing to see so many people playing the game, sharing their thoughts and feedback with us, and a special thanks to everyone who has shared their exploits online. After two weeks of Screencheat mayhem, we’re finally ready to unleash out first content drop for you all to test.

Content Drop #1 adds a new map called Helix. Dubbed by Nick as a “[i]forgotten temple in the sky where death is always around the corner,[/i]” this map features multiple levels, air vents that shoot you too the roof, and a tonne of interesting movement options. The colour scheme is wildly different from the previous maps, so you will need to concentrate more on your surroundings. Here’s a pro tip - quickly learn which side of the map is pristine, and which side is in ruins, it will help you find your prey a lot faster.

[img]http://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/surprise-attack/Community+Hubs/SAG/Pictures/Helix1.jpeg[/img]
[img]http://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/surprise-attack/Community+Hubs/SAG/Pictures/Helix2.jpeg[/img]

We’ve also added a new weapon into the mix! The Chefolet is a modified car engine that shoots a kinetic ball of energy. Hold down the shoot button to charge the weapon - the longer you charge it the faster it becomes, and the longer it will bounce from wall to wall. The tradeoff is that it becomes very easy for people to notice a gigantic glowing orb of death, and they have a chance to take you out before you fire. We’re extremely excited to hear what you guys think of this wonderfully weird, yet deadly creation.

[img]http://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/surprise-attack/Community+Hubs/SAG/Pictures/Chef.jpeg[/img]

Finally, we’ve added a new gameplay mode for you all to experience. One Shot is essentially a hardcore mode where players only get one shot, so they have to make it count. Once everyone has fired their shot, or 15 seconds have elapsed (whichever comes first), everyone automatically reloads and it begins again. This forces you to be more strategic, spam less, and creates some really tense moments.

Samurai Punk has managed to cram some other cool features into this update, including a new Brutal Announcer, along with some extra jibber-jabber for the previous announcer pack. They have also fixed up a number of niggling issues that many of you pointed out, and updated a few things to the game should play a little nicer for all.

The update is now live, so just start the game on Steam and you will be good to go. The changelog is below, but as always we will be hanging around the community hub to answer questions and take your feedback! [b]- Steve[/b]

[h1]Changelog - Build 0.0.11 (18/08/14)[/h1]
[h1]Awesome Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Map - Helix! The forgotten temple in the sky where death is always around the corner.
[*]New Gamemode - One Shot. The hardcore mode, or true Deathmatch, of Screencheat. You only get one shot, so make it count. Once everyone has fired or 15 seconds have elapsed, you get a new shot. Great for ramping up the intensity
[*]New Weapon - Chefolet. Hold down the shoot button to charge this beauty. The longer you charge, the larger, faster and longer living the bouncing ball of death will be.
[*]New Announcer - Brutal Announcer added. Go to the game settings to pick your favourite or leave them randomising.
[*]Extra Announcements - Both announcers now have additional jibber jabber.
[/list]
[h1]Cool Little Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game start now keeps you informed when waiting for players
[*]Game over player listing is now ordered by score. Bragging rights should be easier to note.
[*]Notification in the lobby chat when a new player joins (even if they don’t have an active profile)
[/list]
[h1]Functionality Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Players should no longer be able to escape garden.
[*]Lobbies in the lobby browser no longer show a “join” button when they are full.
[*]Death camera will no longer go through walls and outside the map
[*]No longer possible to get stuck against the wall in the wind tunnels.
[*]Forced OpenGL on Windows. This should avoid issues with alt tabbing under DirectX 9 until a fixed version of the engine we use is released. Let us know if this causes issues for you, and we’ll give you another workaround.
[*]GUI changes everywhere. Our GUI guy included a giant list 30 items long, but I’ll spare you the details. Here’s some of the new things you can interact with.
[*]Added Terrain Detail setting in Graphics Settings
[*]Adds Announcer volume to audio settings
[*]Added “Enter” to select profiles
[*]Convention mode- press back to invert look (mostly for our benefit at conventions, but if you’re playing at a party this one might help you out.
[/list]

notes.title: Content Drop #1 Is Live - Changelog Is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://engagementengine.s3.amazonaws.com/community/articles/normal/content-drop-1-is-now-live-ve.jpg[/img]

Hello Screencheaters! It has been amazing to see so many people playing the game, sharing their thoughts and feedback with us, and a special thanks to everyone who has shared their exploits online. After two weeks of Screencheat mayhem, we’re finally ready to unleash out first content drop for you all to test.

Content Drop #1 adds a new map called Helix. Dubbed by Nick as a “[i]forgotten temple in the sky where death is always around the corner,[/i]” this map features multiple levels, air vents that shoot you too the roof, and a tonne of interesting movement options. The colour scheme is wildly different from the previous maps, so you will need to concentrate more on your surroundings. Here’s a pro tip - quickly learn which side of the map is pristine, and which side is in ruins, it will help you find your prey a lot faster.

[img]http://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/surprise-attack/Community+Hubs/SAG/Pictures/Helix1.jpeg[/img]
[img]http://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/surprise-attack/Community+Hubs/SAG/Pictures/Helix2.jpeg[/img]

We’ve also added a new weapon into the mix! The Chefolet is a modified car engine that shoots a kinetic ball of energy. Hold down the shoot button to charge the weapon - the longer you charge it the faster it becomes, and the longer it will bounce from wall to wall. The tradeoff is that it becomes very easy for people to notice a gigantic glowing orb of death, and they have a chance to take you out before you fire. We’re extremely excited to hear what you guys think of this wonderfully weird, yet deadly creation.

[img]http://s3-ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com/surprise-attack/Community+Hubs/SAG/Pictures/Chef.jpeg[/img]

Finally, we’ve added a new gameplay mode for you all to experience. One Shot is essentially a hardcore mode where players only get one shot, so they have to make it count. Once everyone has fired their shot, or 15 seconds have elapsed (whichever comes first), everyone automatically reloads and it begins again. This forces you to be more strategic, spam less, and creates some really tense moments.

Samurai Punk has managed to cram some other cool features into this update, including a new Brutal Announcer, along with some extra jibber-jabber for the previous announcer pack. They have also fixed up a number of niggling issues that many of you pointed out, and updated a few things to the game should play a little nicer for all.

The update is now live, so just start the game on Steam and you will be good to go. The changelog is below, but as always we will be hanging around the community hub to answer questions and take your feedback! [b]- Steve[/b]

[h1]Changelog - Build 0.0.11 (18/08/14)[/h1]
[h1]Awesome Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]New Map - Helix! The forgotten temple in the sky where death is always around the corner.
[*]New Gamemode - One Shot. The hardcore mode, or true Deathmatch, of Screencheat. You only get one shot, so make it count. Once everyone has fired or 15 seconds have elapsed, you get a new shot. Great for ramping up the intensity
[*]New Weapon - Chefolet. Hold down the shoot button to charge this beauty. The longer you charge, the larger, faster and longer living the bouncing ball of death will be.
[*]New Announcer - Brutal Announcer added. Go to the game settings to pick your favourite or leave them randomising.
[*]Extra Announcements - Both announcers now have additional jibber jabber.
[/list]
[h1]Cool Little Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game start now keeps you informed when waiting for players
[*]Game over player listing is now ordered by score. Bragging rights should be easier to note.
[*]Notification in the lobby chat when a new player joins (even if they don’t have an active profile)
[/list]
[h1]Functionality Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Players should no longer be able to escape garden.
[*]Lobbies in the lobby browser no longer show a “join” button when they are full.
[*]Death camera will no longer go through walls and outside the map
[*]No longer possible to get stuck against the wall in the wind tunnels.
[*]Forced OpenGL on Windows. This should avoid issues with alt tabbing under DirectX 9 until a fixed version of the engine we use is released. Let us know if this causes issues for you, and we’ll give you another workaround.
[*]GUI changes everywhere. Our GUI guy included a giant list 30 items long, but I’ll spare you the details. Here’s some of the new things you can interact with.
[*]Added Terrain Detail setting in Graphics Settings
[*]Adds Announcer volume to audio settings
[*]Added “Enter” to select profiles
[*]Convention mode- press back to invert look (mostly for our benefit at conventions, but if you’re playing at a party this one might help you out.
[/list]
[h1]Minor Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*]Museum cleaned up a little.
[*]Garden lower path modified to make it feel less maze like.
[*]Upper walkways on Garden hills should now be less camp-able.
[*]Fix black defocus background sometimes covering pause menu in-game

[/list]
